answer.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE tag_parts(post_id, rest, tag) AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.Tags, NULL
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
  WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
    AND p.CommentCount = 0
    AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT post_id,
         substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1),
         substr(rest, instr(rest, '<') + 1, instr(rest, '>') - instr(rest, '<') - 1)
  FROM tag_parts
  WHERE rest <> '' AND instr(rest, '<') > 0 AND instr(rest, '>') > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM tag_parts
WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> ''
ORDER BY tag;

tool_arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE tag_parts(post_id, rest, tag) AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.Tags, NULL
  FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
  WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.CommentCount = 0 AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT post_id,
         CASE WHEN instr(rest, '>') > 0 THEN substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1) ELSE '' END,
         CASE WHEN instr(rest, '>') > 0 THEN substr(rest, instr(rest, '<') + 1, instr(rest, '>') - instr(rest, '<') - 1) ELSE NULL END
  FROM tag_parts
  WHERE rest <> '' AND instr(rest, '<') > 0 AND instr(rest, '>') > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM tag_parts
WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> ''
ORDER BY tag;

WITH comment_counts AS (
  SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS comment_count
  FROM comments
  WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY UserId
), top_users AS (
  SELECT UserId, comment_count
  FROM comment_counts
  WHERE comment_count = (SELECT MAX(comment_count) FROM comment_counts)
)
SELECT u.Id AS UserId, u.DisplayName, tu.comment_count,
       (SELECT group_concat(Name, ', ')
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM badges WHERE UserId = u.Id ORDER BY Name)) AS Badges
FROM top_users tu
JOIN users u ON u.Id = tu.UserId
ORDER BY u.Id;
